title: Test on this thread runs an unsaved prompt and stores nothing
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData and open any conversation
In Settings › AI › Prompts edit One-line summary without saving
Press Test under Test on this thread
Close the editor and look at the conversation's one-line summary
expected: The answer, the conversation's subject and the prompt id with +draft appear under the button. The prompt is not saved (no Edited badge) and the conversation's own summary line is unchanged.
